package.name: 16-pin DIP (CD4049UBE)
package.source: TI CD4049UB data sheet SCHS046L (August 1998, revised February 2026), Figure 4-1 and Pin Functions (p.3): VCC 1, VSS 8; 13 and 16 not connected

fit.sheet: TI CD4049UB data sheet SCHS046L (August 1998, revised February 2026)
fit.figure: Figures 5-3 and 5-5, typical output sink and source current (p.12); Figure 5-7, voltage transfer characteristic (p.13); Figure 5-9, power per inverter
fit.method: Two ngspice VDMOS (N and P), each source on its rail, fitted to the typical sink and source curves at 5, 10 and 15 V with the thresholds started from Figure 5-7's switching points; capacitances from Figure 5-9's power at 100 kHz; input protection diodes as the p.1 schematic, at ngspice's defaults. Scripts .claude/skills/fit-model/worked/cd4049/ (fit.py, write_lib.py, check.py).
fit.note: Figure 5-7 draws only −55 °C and 125 °C; 25 °C is taken 80/180 of the way between them. The table's typical IOH is ignored (it contradicts Figure 5-5 and the switching points). Every min/max line of the table is met; the typical curves within 20 % but at 5 V (sink −25 %, source +36 % at the ends). The small-signal gain (32 at 9 V) follows the drawn slope, the sheet has no gain figure; the model switches about twice as fast as the AC table's typicals (inside every max).
